model_name: Repressilator - symmetric six-variable transcriptional oscillator (Elowitz & Leibler 2000)
description: Symmetric cyclic negative-feedback network of three transcriptional repressors (LacI, TetR, CI) and their mRNAs in E. coli. Each repressor inhibits transcription of the next gene in the cycle (LacI |- tetR |- cI |- lacI). This is the deterministic continuous (rescaled) model of Box 1: six coupled first-order ODEs with Hill-type repression (coefficient n) and first-order mRNA/protein decay. Variables are dimensionless: protein concentrations in units of KM, mRNA rescaled by translation efficiency, time in units of the mRNA lifetime.

variables.name: m_lacI
variables.description: lacI mRNA concentration (rescaled by translation efficiency)

variables.name: m_tetR
variables.description: tetR mRNA concentration (rescaled by translation efficiency)

variables.name: m_cI
variables.description: cI mRNA concentration (rescaled by translation efficiency)

variables.name: p_lacI
variables.description: LacI repressor protein concentration (in units of KM)

variables.name: p_tetR
variables.description: TetR repressor protein concentration (in units of KM)

variables.name: p_cI
variables.description: CI repressor protein concentration (in units of KM)

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.unit: protein copies per cell, in units of KM
parameters.description: Maximal (unrepressed) promoter strength. Paper states fully-induced transcription 0.5 transcripts/s, translation efficiency 20 proteins/transcript, protein half-life 10 min, KM=40 per cell. Steady-state protein number in absence of repression = 0.5*20/(ln2/600 s)=8658 per cell; divided by KM=40 -> ~216.

parameters.name: alpha0
parameters.unit: protein copies per cell, in units of KM
parameters.description: Promoter leakiness at saturating repression. From repressed transcription rate 5e-4 transcripts/s: 5e-4*20/(ln2/600)/40 -> ~0.216.

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: Ratio of protein decay rate to mRNA decay rate. From protein half-life 10 min and mRNA half-life 2 min: beta=(ln2/10)/(ln2/2)=0.2.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Hill coefficient of cooperative repression (paper states n=2).

origin.source_text: Elowitz, M.B. & Leibler, S. A synthetic oscillatory network of transcriptional regulators. Nature 403, 335-338 (2000). Box 1, deterministic continuous approximation.
assumptions: Symmetric case: all three repressors identical except for their DNA-binding specificities (single set of parameters alpha, alpha0, beta, n).
Repression of transcription described by a Hill function alpha/(1+p^n) with Hill coefficient n.
First-order (exponential) decay of both mRNA and protein.
Continuous, deterministic approximation; molecular discreteness and stochasticity are neglected (the paper treats these separately in its stochastic model).
Time is rescaled in units of the mRNA lifetime; protein concentrations in units of KM.

missing_information: Initial conditions m_i(0) and p_i(0): the paper does not report them (only all downstream parameter values). A chosen, symmetry-breaking set of initial values is used for the numerical simulation.

The exact algebraic mapping of the reported dimensional quantities (0.5 transcripts/s, translation efficiency 20, half-lives, KM=40) onto the dimensionless alpha and alpha0 is not printed explicitly; the values alpha=216, alpha0=0.216 follow from the stated rescalings.
Not stated: whether the plotted Fig. 1c used these exact alpha/alpha0 values, which specific point 'X' of the stability diagram (Fig. 1b) they correspond to.
